text: {"lessons":["I sold several positions that were above my average cost; I should not take profits just to lock in a gain or hold a losing position to avoid admitting a mistake.","I should judge decisions by their future prospects and risk, not by each stock’s separate gain or loss since I bought it.","A few months of price history do not predict what comes next, so I should avoid reacting to short-term moves and trade only when my plan gives a reason."]}
